title: બધું જ વધુ
caption: ભાગ ૨: ScoreMyBiz તમારી દુકાન માટે શું કરે છે, અસલી સ્ક્રીન પર. લુમિ બાકીનું બતાવે છે.
linkedin_text: Part 2 of the ScoreMyBiz tour on its real screens: today's totals in a hurry, every sale and payment with one customer, items and last prices, asking your numbers on WhatsApp, entries that wait safely when there is no signal, break-even, goals, the score over time, the decision game and the year-end close.
